_doc: Single-session close payload. Top-level keys are the readStdin ALLOWED_KEYS (handoff.js:994-999). Field shapes: tldr=string, open_threads=string[], quick_references=string, entities=[{name,entity_type,description}], assertions=[{subject,predicate,object,confidence,source}], edges=[{from_entity,edge_type,to_entity,weight}]. Carries DISTINCTIVE marker tokens so sibling tests can grep for survival.
tldr: NS-TLDR-MARKER: Implemented the resurrection ring and verified the Matryoshka-truncated embed path end to end. Next session must continue the production backfill of live assertions.
open_threads: NS-THREAD-ALPHA: finish the production backfill of all live assertions to halfvec(4000)
NS-THREAD-BRAVO: wire smoketest-resurrect-real-vllm.js into the pre-release CI gate
NS-THREAD-CHARLIE: decide whether L1 patient-adversary defense ships this cycle or defers
NS-THREAD-DELTA: reconcile the legacy encoded-cwd project_settings remnant rows
quick_references: NS-REF-ONE: lib/embed.js Matryoshka truncation lives at the EMBED_DIMS slice. NS-REF-TWO: resurrect engine fuzzy fallback uses the assertions_trgm_text_idx GIN index. NS-REF-THREE: the close payload schema is enforced in readStdin (handoff.js).
